About the mill

A Narowal mill with a simple standard.

Bajwa Flour Mills serves the local wholesale market from 3-Km Muridke Road. The business focuses on wheat products and straightforward distribution — the essentials behind a dependable flour supply.

For trade quantities, pack availability or the current government package, speak directly with the mill team.

“Our product speaks itself. We deal with top quality wheat products.”

From wheat to flour.

A clear view of the standard milling journey — from incoming grain through cleaning, grinding, sifting and packing.

01

Receive

Wheat enters the mill and is prepared for processing.

02

Clean

Dust and unwanted material are separated from the grain.

03

Mill

Prepared wheat is ground through controlled milling stages.

04

Sift

Flour is separated to achieve the intended texture and consistency.

05

Pack

Finished flour is packed for household and wholesale distribution.
